claim: LATEST_PROTOCOL_VERSION is 2026-07-28; JSON-RPC is 2.0; protocol version and client capabilities are carried per request; servers must not infer capabilities from prior requests.
The published 2026-07-28 JSON Schema uses JSON Schema draft 2020-12 and distinguishes protocol errors from tool-reported errors.
The 2026-07-28 revision removes protocol-level sessions, Mcp-Session-Id, initialize and notifications/initialized; requests are self-describing.
The 2026-07-28 specification release describes a stateless protocol core and authorization hardening.
